chrome_hint: eBay Australia sold listings: 'kukri brass inlay scabbard' and 'gurkha kukri souvenir timber scabbard'; Terapeak same terms, last 12 months; Noble Numismatics archive 'kukri'; LiveAuctioneers/Invaluable sold 'kukri brass inlaid scabbard'. Look for SOLD prices on tourist kukris with decorated scabbards.
viewing_check: Check ricasso and blade for any stamp (maker, arsenal, date, 'MKII' or Indian ordnance marks); whether the blade is steel with a tang through the grip; scabbard condition (inlay loose, missing karda/chakmak) and pitting depth. A military stamp would lift value well above tourist grade.
